This is the Nxeon hosting platform, a Next.js/TypeScript/Prisma app. Production is /opt/nxeon (git repo, don't touch directly). Create a worktree off main for this: `git worktree add /opt/nxeon-wt-wizardgames -b hotfix/wizard-games-tab main` from /opt/nxeon.

TASK 1 — dedupe the deploy wizard's Applications tab:
The VPS deploy wizard (step 2 "Install", at app/dashboard/deploy or similar — grep for "Choose what to install" or the tab labels "Operating Systems"/"Control Panels"/"Applications"/"Games" to find the source, likely a client component reading from some catalog/config) currently lists a bunch of GAME servers (ARK: Survival Evolved, Satisfactory, Project Zomboid, 7 Days to Die, V Rising, Enshrouded, Factorio, Garry's Mod, Conan Exiles, Unturned, The Forest, Sons of the Forest, Minecraft Bedrock) under the "Applications" tab, duplicating what's already properly listed under the "Games" tab. Remove all game entries from Applications — Applications should only contain genuine apps/services (Docker, WordPress, LAMP Stack, Node.js, Caddy, WireGuard VPN, OpenVPN, Vaultwarden, Pi-hole, Uptime Kuma, Gitea, Jellyfin, etc). Find wherever this catalog/list is defined (likely a shared OsTemplate/app-catalog source, possibly prisma/catalog.ts or a lib/*.ts file feeding both the DB seed and this UI) and fix the categorization at the source so both the wizard and any other place that reads it stay consistent — don't just filter it client-side in the wizard component if the underlying category field is wrong.

TASK 2 — real game cover art in the Games tab:
The Games tab currently renders each game with a plain single-letter avatar (e.g. "M" for Minecraft, "V" for V Rising, "R" for Rust, "P" for Palworld, "C" for Counter-Strike 2, "T" for Terraria) instead of actual game cover/poster art. A prior session (per project memory) already added ~31 game hero/poster images and a per-game hero backdrop convention elsewhere in the game-servers pages — find where those live (grep for existing usages of per-game poster/hero images, likely under public/games/ or similar, or check how /game-servers/[game] pages render their hero image — there's likely a GAME_META or similar catalog with image paths per game slug). Reuse that exact same image source/convention for the wizard's Games tab tile art — do not invent new artwork or use placeholder icons. If a specific game in the wizard list has no existing cover image, leave a clear TODO comment naming it rather than fabricating one.

After both fixes: `ln -sfn /opt/nxeon/node_modules node_modules && ln -sf /opt/nxeon/.env .env` in the worktree, run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` to confirm clean, then `git add`+commit with a clear message (Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>). Do NOT merge to main or deploy — just get it committed on the branch and leave the worktree in place for review. Before finishing, delete node_modules and .next from the worktree to avoid bloating disk (this server has hit 100% disk from accumulated worktree node_modules before — always clean up).

Report back: what you found and changed, a screenshot-equivalent description of the before/after tab contents, which games (if any) are missing cover art, and confirm build passed.

Everything is committed cleanly on branch `hotfix/wizard-games-tab`, worktree is left in place (not merged, not deployed), and node_modules/.next were removed after the build check.

## Report

**Root cause found:** The 13 "extra" game entries (ARK, Satisfactory, Project Zomboid, 7 Days to Die, V Rising, Enshrouded, Factorio, Garry's Mod, Conan Exiles, Unturned, The Forest, Sons of the Forest, Minecraft Bedrock) are correctly seeded in the DB as `OsTemplate.category = "APPLICATION"` (via `prisma/seed-wave1-games.ts` / `seed-wave2-games.ts`) — that part of the schema is fine, since all install-catalog rows (OS/panel/app/game) share one `APPLICATION`-ish clone+setupScript mechanism. The actual bug was in `components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx`: it kept its own **local, stale** `GAME_FAMILIES` set (only the original 6: minecraft/valheim/rust/palworld/cs2/terraria) to peel games out of the Applications tab into the Games tab. Every game added since fell through that stale set and duplicated into Applications. `lib/games.ts` already exports a canonical, documented `GAME_FAMILIES` list of all 19 families (added in a prior session specifically to prevent this exact class of drift) — the wizard just wasn't using it. I also found the identical bug, with *no* filter at all, in `app/(marketing)/vps/page.tsx`'s "One-click apps" showcase.

**Changes (both on `hotfix/wizard-games-tab`, commit `4d57629`):**
- `components/customer/DeployWizard.tsx` — replaced the local 6-game `Set` with an import of `GAME_FAMILIES` from `@/lib/games`, so Applications/Games stay correctly split as new games are added, with no future copy-paste risk.
- `app/(marketing)/vps/page.tsx` — same fix applied to its `byCat("APPLICATION")` filter.
- Games tab tile rendering in `DeployWizard.tsx` swapped from `AppLogo` (generic app-icon/emoji/first-letter fallback) to `GameCoverTile`, the same real poster-art component (`public/games/art/<slug>_poster.jpg` drop-in chain) already used by the dedicated Game Server wizard and `/game-servers` pages.

**Before/after (VPS wizard, step 2 "Choose what to install"):**
- Before — Applications tab: Docker, WordPress, LAMP, Node.js, Nextcloud, Caddy, WireGuard, OpenVPN, Vaultwarden, Pi-hole, Uptime Kuma, Gitea, Jellyfin, **plus 13 duplicate games**. Games tab: only the original 6 games, rendered as small generic app-icon chips.
- After — Applications tab: only the 13 genuine apps. Games tab: all 19 games, each rendered as a real portrait cover-art tile (poster image, name + license badge overlay), matching the dedicated Game Server product's look.

**Missing cover art:** none — all 19 game families already have art via `lib/games.ts`'s `GAME_ART_SLUG` map, verified present on disk (e.g. `public/games/art/ark-asa_poster.jpg`, `.../conan-exiles_poster.jpg`, etc.), and Minecraft resolves through its documented fallback chain (`public/logos/games/covers/minecraft.jpg`). No TODO placeholders were needed.

**Cleanup:** `node_modules` symlink, `.env` symlink, and `.next` were all removed from the worktree after the build check; `git status` is clean and disk usage is at 52% (23G free on `/`).
